summary: Verify Nightly browser job 139139045870 failed 'Each mode starts with its riders in seat order [Trio]' and 'Each rider has its own starting cell and direction [Nova]': reading a Light Cycles board took one native-browser round trip per attribute (about 50 for four riders), so the read outlasted the 3-second countdown and its round, read last, no longer matched the riders read first.
